heading: MIV II - Legacy

text: The MIV II, a member of the M II Family of Relays, is a digital device that provides voltage and frequency protection for a wide range of applications at any voltage level. The MIV II can be ordered with one of the following options:
heading: MIV II - Legacy

text: Four independent time delay phase under/overvoltage elements complete with two independent fixed time ground overvoltage elements
heading: MIV II - Legacy

text: Both voltage protection and two elements of frequency protection
heading: MIV II - Legacy

text: Use the MIV II also to protect electrical machines like transformers, generators or motors against restricted earth faults.
heading: MIV II - Legacy

text: Configurable logic, curves, I/Os and LEDs
heading: Features & Benefits

text: Automatic display of last fault information
heading: Features & Benefits

text: Three models available for voltage, frequency and combined protection
heading: Features & Benefits

heading: Features & Benefits

heading: Features & Benefits
